lines.zh: 我趴在树枝上，一寸一寸挪。
lines.en: I creep along the branch an inch at a time.

lines.zh: 我的爪子扣住树皮，很牢。
lines.en: My claws catch the bark and hold.

lines.zh: 尾巴垂下去，慢悠悠地摆。
lines.en: My tail hangs down, swaying lazily.

lines.zh: 我从一根枝跳到另一根。
lines.en: I leap from one branch to the next.

lines.zh: 我趴在石头上，晒够了才走。
lines.en: I lie on a stone until I have had enough sun.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，叶子还在晃。
lines.en: The leaves keep moving after I pass.

lines.zh: 我的喉咙下面有一片皮。
lines.en: There is a flap of skin under my throat.

lines.zh: 我贴着树干斜着往上爬。
lines.en: I climb the trunk at an angle.

lines.zh: 我一步一停，先看清再说。
lines.en: One step, one pause. Look, then move.

lines.zh: 我的棘刺会立起来，也会落下。
lines.en: My spines rise and settle.

lines.zh: 脚下的树皮掉了一小片。
lines.en: A flake of bark falls away under me.

lines.zh: 我从低处的枝滑到地上。
lines.en: I slide from a low branch to the ground.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像块带刺的树皮。
lines.en: I lie still as a thorny strip of bark.
The sun makes my eyes half close.

lines.zh: 我在等一只虫自己爬近。
lines.en: I wait for an insect to crawl within reach.
My spines lie along my back.
The skin under my throat puffs once.
A bird is nearby. I do not move.
I am green from head to tail.

lines.zh: 我用舌头舔了一下眼睛。
lines.en: I lick my eye.

lines.zh: 树枝在我重量下轻轻弯。
lines.en: The branch bends slightly under me.

lines.zh: 风把我的棘刺吹得动了动。
lines.en: The wind stirs my spines.

lines.zh: 我换了个姿势，还是趴着。
lines.en: I shift position, still lying flat.

lines.zh: 我在数树上有几只蚂蚁。
lines.en: I am counting the ants on this tree.

lines.zh: 这个高度很好，能看见远处。
lines.en: This height is good. I can see far.

lines.zh: 我抬头，又低下去，什么也没发生。
lines.en: I raise my head, lower it. Nothing happened.

lines.zh: 你走近了，我没有马上跑。
lines.en: You come near. I do not bolt at once.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在头两侧，都看着你。
lines.en: My eyes sit on the sides of my head. Both see you.

lines.zh: 你身上有股树叶的味道。
lines.en: You smell of leaves.

lines.zh: 我把头往上抬，看清你的手。
lines.en: I lift my head and look at your hands.
If you keep off, I will keep lying here.

lines.zh: 你伸手，我的棘刺立起来了。
lines.en: You reach out. My spines rise.
Step back and they lie flat again.

lines.zh: 我不是那种会跳过来的东西。
lines.en: I am not the sort to leap at you.

lines.zh: 我看了看你，又看了看退路。
lines.en: I look at you, then at my escape route.
Closer and I will take to the tree.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴轻轻敲了一下树枝。
lines.en: My tail taps the branch once.
Your laugh does not sound like catching.
I think I will watch a little longer.

lines.zh: 你要是一直站着，我就一直趴着。
lines.en: If you keep standing there, I will keep lying here.

lines.zh: 这是我能给的最大让步。
lines.en: That is the most I can concede.
I blink one slit pupil and stay still.
Let that be my answer.
Now I trust you a little.

lines.zh: 我从枝上滑了一下，抓住才没掉。
lines.en: I slip on the branch and catch myself.
Every spine on me stands up.
I shift to the other side of the trunk.

lines.zh: 尾巴被抓住，我先断它一截。
lines.en: My tail is caught; I shed a piece of it.
A pale line is left on my hide.
I open my mouth and hiss.
I press against the bark and freeze.
This leg will not fold back.
My breathing has quickened.
Higher up will be safer.
That leaf is a tender green.
I raise my head and stretch my neck.
I move half a body length toward you.

lines.zh: 你放在枝上，我就下来吃。
lines.en: Set it on the branch and I will come down.
I eat slowly.
One bite takes a long time to chew.
I tilt my head, wary you might take it back.
This is sweeter than the leaves up here.

lines.zh: 吃完我还会看着你的手。
lines.en: When it is gone I will keep watching your hand.
Any more? I only ask.

lines.zh: 你撞到树枝，我差点掉下去。
lines.en: You knock the branch and I nearly fall.
My claws grip harder.

lines.zh: 我从你手边滑过去，落在地上。
lines.en: I slip past your hand and drop to the ground.

lines.zh: 我在你脚边停了一下，又跑了。
lines.en: I pause at your feet, then run.

lines.zh: 我尾巴一甩，鳞片擦过你。
lines.en: My tail whips; scales scrape your leg.

lines.zh: 这一下不算什么，我皮厚。
lines.en: That is nothing. My hide is thick.
I retreat behind the trunk.
You move too abruptly.

lines.zh: 我需要一会儿才敢再出来。
lines.en: It will take me a while to come out again.

lines.zh: 碰撞对我来说就是危险。
lines.en: A collision means danger to me.
Another is on the tree across from mine.
I bob my head several times.
She bobs hers back at me.
I climb across, slowly.
The skin under my throat puffs out.
My spines stand in a row.

lines.zh: 我们在同一根枝上晒太阳。
lines.en: We sun ourselves on the same branch.
Neither moves. That is enough.

lines.zh: 这个季节树上有很多果子。
lines.en: There is fruit on the trees this season.
I drop first; she follows.
I take it in my mouth and shake it.
Not a leaf. I spit it out.
I press it down with a claw.
It rolls off the branch.
I nudge it into the fork of the branch.

lines.zh: 背上的棘，比这东西好嚼。
lines.en: The spines on my back chew better than this.
I look at it a long while and leave it.
It is caught on my spines.
I shake myself and it falls.
What falls I do not want.

lines.zh: 有只虫在叶上，我看见了。
lines.en: An insect on a leaf. I see it.
My head turns slowly toward it.
I press flat against the branch.
It is a hand's length away.
I do not hurry to open my mouth.

lines.zh: 我的舌头已经抬起来了。
lines.en: My tongue is already lifting.
The bug has moved.
I move with it.
This bite must be true.
I lie on the branch, gathering myself.
Something has climbed into my tree.
I watch it through a gap in the leaves.
It is much bigger than a bug.

lines.zh: 我把身子压低，和树皮一色。
lines.en: I flatten until I match the bark.

lines.zh: 它要是上来，我就往下溜。
lines.en: If it climbs, I slip downward.
I turn my head its way.
I stare at it without moving my eyes.
It hides under the leaf; I go around.
I inch along the branch.
My claws make no sound.
It is still chewing leaves.
That is good for me.
Another inch closer.
My shadow falls beside it.
It has stopped dead.
Now it is too late.
My throat pouch swells; I'm ready to bite.
My tongue arrives before my teeth.
It circles the tree; I turn with it.
My head stays pointed down.
It looks up; I freeze.
The bark hides half of me.

lines.zh: 它踩响落叶，我数到第三下。
lines.en: It cracks leaves; I count to three.

lines.zh: 它停下来，我也停，尾巴还晒着太阳。
lines.en: It stopped and so did I, tail still sunning.

lines.zh: 舌头一弹，就把它黏住了。
lines.en: My tongue flicks and sticks to it.
I bite down and it crunches.

lines.zh: 我慢慢咽下去，尾巴还在摆。
lines.en: I swallow slowly, my tail still swaying.
I swallow slowly.
Something falls from the branch.
I look up. Not food.

lines.zh: 我的棘刺立了一会儿才平。
lines.en: My spines stay up a while before settling.
I settle back where I was.
This meal will last me a day.
The sun has not set. I keep waiting.

lines.zh: 它伸手上来，我咬了一口。
lines.en: It reaches up and I bite.
My tail whips its hand.
I flee upward along the trunk.
My claws leave a pale scratch.
I hiss, harshly.
It pulls back; only then do I relax.
Vines part, and my scaled back emerges.

lines.zh: 这棵树的树皮很粗，好抓。
lines.en: The bark here is rough and easy to grip.

lines.zh: 我沿着树干往下爬了两尺。
lines.en: I climb two feet down the trunk.

lines.zh: 阳光从叶缝里落在我背上。
lines.en: Sun falls on my back through the leaves.

lines.zh: 我闻到了另一只鬣蜥的味道。
lines.en: I smell another iguana.

lines.zh: 四周很湿，是雨林的气味。
lines.en: It is damp, the smell of rainforest.
I coil my tail around the branch.

lines.zh: 我趴在枝上，尾巴垂下去。
lines.en: On a branch, tail hanging down.
I raise my head slowly and look below.
Something moves below. I do not know it.
I will stay still until it passes.
I will come to know this place.

lines.zh: 我从卵里出来的时候很小。
lines.en: I was tiny when I left the egg.
This tree is mine now.

lines.zh: 我慢慢爬到能晒到太阳的枝。
lines.en: I crawl to a branch where the sun reaches.

lines.zh: 我的颜色和叶子分不清。
lines.en: My color is lost among the leaves.
I hear water running far off.

lines.zh: 这一片林子够我待很久。
lines.en: This wood will hold me a long while.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的背，我掉下树就跑。
lines.en: Fire scorches my back; I drop and run.

lines.zh: 我从枝上摔下去，肚皮先着地。
lines.en: I fall from the branch and land on my belly.

lines.zh: 水灌进嘴里，我拼命划着往上。
lines.en: Water fills my mouth; I claw upward.

lines.zh: 一声炸响，我被震下树去。
lines.en: A blast knocks me out of the tree.

lines.zh: 我趴在枝上，爪子扣着树皮。
lines.en: I lie on the branch, claws hooked in the bark.

lines.zh: 那光把我的四肢钉住了。
lines.en: That light nails my limbs in place.

lines.zh: 好几天没吃到叶子，身上没劲。
lines.en: Days without leaves; I have no strength.

lines.zh: 雷劈在树上，我整条麻了。
lines.en: Lightning hits the tree and I go numb.

lines.zh: 树枝不见了，我在黑里往下落。
lines.en: The branch is gone and I fall through black.
